dedupe_keys.name: network and configuration data for a scheduling based approach to railway capacity estimation for industrial freight junctions

description: The research team publishes railway infrastructure JSON and scenario YAML files for a freight junction serving a northern-Adriatic port. Zenodo makes nine files available under CC BY 4.0. Two configurations represent current and expanded buffer tracks with four terminals, a shared track network and a passenger timetable. Scenarios set minimum and maximum freight services for satisfiability or throughput maximisation; the deposit documents units, track capacities and a twenty-four-hour operating period. These inputs can benchmark rail-junction scheduling and port-access capacity models. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this exact configuration set. Coverage is a representative subnetwork, not the full port rail system. A limitation is that a constraint-programming model and demand assumptions determine any throughput result; the network file alone does not establish observed capacity. The JSON and YAML files were not downloaded and no schedule was solved.
